# android draws a canvas through its Compose overrides, which are Kotlin. Under
# `--lang go` the synthesized draw function is emitted into golib, where
# `drawRect` and `Offset` are undefined and the Compose import path is not a Go
# package at all -- so the generated project fails at `go build` rather than
# here.
#
# Before the shapes became overrides this combination panicked in the Go
# backend on an untranslated canvas intrinsic. The report is that loud failure
# staying loud.
! sngl generate --lang=go --platform=android --out=bad app.sngl
stderr 'Compose, which is Kotlin'
stderr 'build this program with --lang kotlin'

# The Kotlin half is unaffected.
sngl generate --lang=kotlin --platform=android --out=ok app.sngl
exists ok/MainScreen.kt
grep 'drawRect' ok/MainScreen.kt

# And a program with no canvas still builds under --lang go, which is what says
# the refusal is about the drawing and not about the language.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=android --out=plain plain.sngl
exists plain/golib/golib.go

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

ui.window {
    draw.canvas(width=40px, height=20px) {
        draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=8.0, h=4.0, style=draw.CanvasStyle{fill=color{r=255}})
    }
}
-- plain.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

func label() string { return "hi" }

ui.window {
    ui.text(value=label())
}
